name: Harbor town — an open civic world
description: A small open-world geography: Bayside is a harbor town; Greyrock is an island with a lighthouse; a ferry runs Bayside→Greyrock. Authored as facts only, with no closure — so the record is a sample of a larger world, not the whole of it. As a game board it produces the *independent* outcome: a proposal the facts neither confirm nor deny (e.g. 'Bayside hosts a market') reads UNKNOWN — a candidate new fact, not a falsehood. The contrast piece to zoo_world's closed taxonomy.
